decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range builds directly on the firm's established consumer health offer and pharmacy channel, so the firm can interpret and act on market feedback easily.
The skin and hair supplement extends the established Trivital line and uses the firm's existing knowledge of formulation and pharmacy marketing, so it fits the portfolio-broadening strategy.
The joint health supplement is closely related to existing products and was moved from a mention to its own page in 2019, which suggests continued support.
The immune supplement was actively promoted as the newest member of the Trivital line, and it relies on knowledge the firm already holds.

The generic valsartan is distant from the core offer and was hit by the 2018 valsartan contamination problem, but the firm's quality-control and regulatory capabilities let it handle API sourcing issues, so keeping it is still more likely.

The OTC triptan is further from the core offer, but it draws on the firm's in-house pharmaceutical development, manufacturing and pharmacy channel, and it matches the strategy of expanding consumer health products.
